summary: Grant County, OR wooden lookout about three miles north of Monument, built 1946-47, last staffed 1978, torn down in 2009; no public access.

facts.design: 55-foot wooden L-4 tower (Register and firelookout.com); 1947 district report lists a 52-foot prefabricated tower with a 14x14 house
facts.status_note: Torn down in 2009; no source we read describes what remains at the site

access.note: Register and firelookout.com both say there is no public access

events.note: April 1945 plan for a 50-foot lookout tower about three miles north of Monument, with a 14x14 cabin on top
Four main posts up by June 28, 1946; the tower came in by truck in August 1946
Clayton Sweek to be lookout man through the 1946 fire season
Register gives build year 1947; 1947 district report lists a 52-foot prefabricated tower with a 14x14 house
Aubrey Crum and Mrs. Crum move into the Monument Lookout on June 14, 1948
Mrs. Edna Crum released from her duties as lookout on October 4, 1951
Lookout painted; trap door, railings, windows and screens repaired
Threatened by a forest fire in 2001
Torn down in 2009; Forest Lookouts says the 55-foot tower was removed during the winter
Registered June 24, 2011 as FFLOS US 1074, OR 432; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: 15.2 m (50 ft) matches the April 1945 plan for a 50-foot tower. The tower built in 1946-47 was 52 ft per the 1947 district report and 55 ft per the Register and firelookout.com; we used 55 ft because two sources agree on it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts shows the posts going up in June 1946 and the tower arriving in August 1946, while the Register gives the build year as 1947. Both are supported: work was under way in 1946, and the Register's 1947 date is the year it lists.

The 1945 plan says 50 feet, the 1947 district report says 52 feet, and the Register and firelookout.com say 55 feet. We used 55 feet as the figure two sources agree on, but the built height is not fully settled.

sources.title: Monument Mountain Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites Register

notes_for_editor: Brief's height_m 15.2 (50 ft) is the 1945 plan, not the built tower; corrected to 55 ft, with 52 ft from the 1947 district report noted as a conflict. Build year: Forest Lookouts shows construction in 1946, Register says 1947. Staffing: Forest Lookouts history stops at 1966 and does not confirm the 1978 last-staffed date, which comes from the Register and firelookout.com only. Access is recorded as closed based on 'There is no public access' (Register and firelookout.com); the brief's 'unknown' should be updated to match. The brief's elevation (1181.4 m) matches the Register's 1,181 m. No source describes what remains at the site. No new photos with URLs found.
